prompts.prompt:
Use case identity-preserve. ArcPet production animation KEY POSES,8chronological scenes in4cols2rows transparent2:1atlas. Input1 exact scene/camera/grid template after book is put down. Input2 approved reading is absolute style/color/proportion authority. Draw each COMPLETE connected cat anew (head/neck/torso/arms/skirt/legs/boots/tail as coherent whole); never assemble or independently transform bodyparts.
The cat is SEATED BEHIND same wooden desk, lampOFF left, mini WHITE DAISIES right. Keep desk/lamp/flowers exact sizes and locations as template. Omit ONLY small wooden stool behind boots (original fixed stool added later). NO BOOK drawn anywhere: original closed book will be composited at its fixed original tabletop position. Keep full original character framing; head x132..330,y76..260, eyes around219, boots bottom424 per448cell. Maintain skull, head-body ratio, shoulder width, thick short legs, brown boots. Mutedgold239/193/157, peach246/222/209, simple plain HIGHNECK offwhite245/242/240, navy89/94/112, brown boots107/84/77. Fine brown cel linework, clean solid fills, no texture/white speckles/holes.
Action: after putting book down, cat CLOSES EYES and stretches BOTH ARMS, peacefully satisfied, then relaxes, still seated. 1 hands resting near closed book location (book NOT drawn), eyes open.2 eyes half-close, hands release tabletop.3 eyes fully closed with clear fine dark lid lines on peach lids, elbows open outward, forearms rise.4 both paws at cheek/ear level, elbows bent naturally, shoulders lift very slightly.5 relaxed strong Y/V stretch, hands just above/beside ears, elbows remain anatomically plausible, shirt underarm/sleeve tension and 2–3px actual chest breath. DO NOT elongate arms/neck or enlarge head to reach high.6 hold stretch with tiny genuine chest/sleeve change and gentle tail flex.7 release tension and lower elbows, eyes stay closed.8 hands settle near tabletop, relaxed closed eyes and calm cat mouth, ready for next scene (NO tomato yet).
No book/tomato/splat, no standing up, no floating detached arms, no crossing through head or sleeves, exactly2hands. Head stays approximately level, original scale stable. Natural small hair tips/hem response during shoulder motion, tail remains continuous. Whole scene fits cell, all paws/ears/boots safely inside margins.
